name: Hanacpachap cussicuinin
about: The processional hymn in Quechua to the Virgin printed by Juan Pérez Bocanegra in his Ritual formulario (Lima, 1631), the first polyphony printed in the Americas: its tiple (treble), read from the print in mensural notation (soprano C clef, B flat), a minim taken as a beat. Sapphic stanzas: three lines of eleven syllables and a short closing line.
